caption:
I paid for an hour of rowing. I have rowed for about four minutes.

A marble sculpture in a rowboat on the Central Park Lake, face to the sun, the San Remo towers behind the trees.
#centralpark #newyorkcity #marblesculpture
alt_text: A living marble sculpture of a woman in a red sleeveless top and navy shorts sits in a rowboat on the Central Park Lake, eyes closed and face turned to the sun, one hand resting on an oar, a straw hat beside her, the twin towers of the San Remo above the trees behind.
